faq.q: How much does Cody Warner charge?
faq.a: Cody Warner publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Cody Warner offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Cody Warner publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Cody Warner have offices?
faq.a: Cody Warner publishes one office, in Manhattan. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Cody Warner?
faq.a: Cody Warner names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 2 of 3 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 1 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.
